title: MolGPAO: Molecular Generative Pre-trained Autoregressive Octree with Speculative Decoding and Sub-Millisecond Seam Healing for 3D Molecules
abstract: arXiv:2611.33985v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive generation over adaptive 3D octrees (Uni-3DAR) offers an intrinsic $O(N \log N)$ sparsity advantage over dense $O(N^2)$ equivariant diffusion and flow models on large drug-like molecules, yet lags in geometric equilibrium, closed-shell valence stability, and property fidelity due to Morton-seam coordinate jumps, leaf-heavy compute with root-count trapping, and target-shortcut collapse in internal critics. We introduce MolGPAO (Molecular Generative Pre-trained Autoregressive Octree), a standalone 3D octree architecture and single-output speculative tree-decoding engine using zero external surrogates, zero reinforcement learning, and zero inference-time MLIP relaxation. translated_title: MolGPAO：具有推测解码与亚毫秒接缝愈合功能的分子生成式预训练自回归八叉树（面向3D分子）
translated_abstract: 在自适应3D八叉树上进行的自回归生成（Uni-3DAR）在大型类药物分子上相比稠密的O(N²)等变扩散与流模型具有内在的O(N log N)稀疏性优势，但由于Morton接缝坐标跳变、偏向叶节点的计算导致的根节点数量困局，以及内部评判器中的目标捷径坍缩，其在几何平衡性、闭壳层价键稳定性和性质保真度方面仍存在不足。我们提出了MolGPAO（分子生成式预训练自回归八叉树），这是一个独立的3D八叉树架构和单输出推测树解码引擎，不使用任何外部代理模型、不使用强化学习、也不在推理时进行MLIP弛豫。MolGPAO统一整合了：(1) 带有L5到L1共价堆积先验的非困局6维ScaleFreeBudgetEmbedding；(2) 基于FlashAttention-2的暂停-汇聚推测八叉树漏斗（m_s1 → m_s2 → 1，M_out = 1）；(3) 反捷径真值训练策略……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出MolGPAO——一个独立的3D八叉树自回归分子生成架构，通过6维无尺度预算嵌入、推测树解码与反捷径训练，在不依赖外部代理、强化学习或推理时MLIP弛豫的情况下，实现对大型类药物分子高效且几何稳定的3D生成。
en_tdlr: MolGPAO introduces a standalone 3D octree autoregressive architecture with scale-free budget embeddings, speculative tree decoding, and anti-shortcut training, enabling efficient and geometrically stable generation of large drug-like 3D molecules without external surrogates, reinforcement learning, or inference-time MLIP relaxation.
